problems.title: Sum the Readings
problems.statement: Return the sum of all integers in numbers. An empty list has a sum of zero.

problems.title: Count Even Readings
problems.statement: Count how many numbers are divisible by two. Zero and negative even integers count.

problems.title: Highest Sensor Value
problems.statement: Find the greatest integer in the non-empty numbers array.

problems.title: First Matching Position
problems.statement: Return the zero-based index of the first occurrence of target. Return -1 if target is absent.

problems.title: Reverse the Message
problems.statement: Return text with all characters in reverse order. Preserve capitalization, spaces, and punctuation.

problems.title: Mirror Word Check
problems.statement: Return true when text reads identically forward and backward. The comparison is case-sensitive and includes spaces.

problems.title: Vowel Counter
problems.statement: Count the English vowels a, e, i, o, u in text. Uppercase and lowercase vowels count equally; y does not count.

problems.title: Count Different Codes
problems.statement: Return the number of distinct integer values in numbers. Count each unique value once.

problems.title: Sorted Order Check
problems.statement: Return true if each element is less than or equal to the element immediately after it. Empty and one-element arrays are sorted.

problems.title: Frequency of a Code
problems.statement: Count the number of positions whose value equals target.

problems.title: Running Energy Total
problems.statement: Return an array where each position contains the sum of all readings up to and including that position.

problems.title: Merge Two Sensor Logs
problems.statement: Merge two individually non-decreasing integer arrays into one non-decreasing array, keeping every occurrence.

problems.title: First Pair Matching a Target
problems.statement: Find two distinct indices i and j with i < j whose values sum to target. Return the lexicographically smallest pair [i,j], or [-1,-1] when no pair exists.

problems.title: First Position in Sorted Data
problems.statement: In a non-decreasing array, return the first index containing target, or -1 if target is absent. Repeated values must return the earliest index.

problems.title: Rotate the Queue
problems.statement: Return the array rotated right by k positions. A rotation moves the last value to the front; an empty array remains empty.

problems.title: Missing Sequence Identifier
problems.statement: numbers contains every integer from 0 through n except exactly one, where n is the array length. Return the missing integer.

problems.title: Longest Online Streak
problems.statement: Given an array containing only 0 and 1, find the longest contiguous run of 1 values.

problems.title: Compact Nonzero Values
problems.statement: Move all zeros to the end of the array while preserving the relative order of nonzero values. Return the resulting array.

problems.title: Runner-Up Measurement
problems.statement: Return the second-largest distinct integer in numbers. Return null when fewer than two distinct values exist.

problems.title: Multiples Label Generator
problems.statement: For each integer from 1 to n, return Fizz when divisible by 3, Buzz when divisible by 5, FizzBuzz when divisible by both, otherwise its decimal string.

problems.title: Best Single Trade
problems.statement: Given prices for consecutive days, buy on one day and sell on a strictly later day to maximize profit. Return 0 if no positive profit exists.

problems.title: Longest Unique-Character Window
problems.statement: Return the maximum length of a contiguous substring that contains no repeated characters. An empty string returns zero.

problems.title: Bracket Sequence Validator
problems.statement: The input contains only (), [], and {} symbols. Return true when every opening bracket is closed by the matching type in correct nesting order.

problems.title: Product of Other Positions
problems.statement: Return an array where result[i] equals the product of all input values except numbers[i]. Use exact integer arithmetic, including zeros.
constraints: The resulting values fit supported integers

problems.title: Count Target-Sum Subarrays
problems.statement: Count non-empty contiguous subarrays whose sum equals target. Negative numbers and zero are allowed.

problems.title: Shortest Sufficient Segment
problems.statement: Given positive integers and a positive target, return the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least target. Return 0 if none exists.

problems.title: Consolidate Time Windows
problems.statement: Merge all closed intervals that overlap or touch at an endpoint. Return merged [start,end] pairs sorted by starting coordinate.
constraints: Each interval has exactly two integers with start <= end

problems.title: Find in a Rotated Log
problems.statement: A strictly increasing array was rotated around a pivot. Return the index of target, or -1 when absent. All values are distinct.
constraints: Array is a rotated strictly increasing sequence

problems.title: Clockwise Matrix Walk
problems.statement: Return the entries of a rectangular integer matrix in clockwise spiral order, starting at its top-left corner and moving right first.

problems.title: Build Pascal Layers
problems.statement: Return the first rows rows of Pascal's triangle. Each row starts and ends with 1; interior entries are the sum of the two entries above.

problems.title: Longest Mirrored Segment
problems.statement: Return the longest contiguous palindromic substring of text. If multiple have the same maximum length, return the one with the smallest starting index.

problems.title: Zigzag Message Layout
problems.statement: Write characters into the specified number of rows by moving down one row at a time, then up diagonally, repeating at boundaries. Return the concatenation of rows from top to bottom.

problems.title: Most Common Signal Codes
problems.statement: Return the k distinct values with highest frequency. Order by descending frequency, then by ascending numeric value for ties.

problems.title: Next Higher Reading
problems.statement: For each index, find the value of the first strictly greater element to its right. Return -1 when no greater value exists.

problems.title: Fewest Tokens for a Sum
problems.statement: Given positive coin denominations (unlimited supply of each), return the fewest coins needed to total amount exactly. Return -1 if impossible.

problems.title: Count Land Regions
problems.statement: A rectangular grid uses 1 for land and 0 for water. Count connected land regions using only up, down, left, and right adjacency.

problems.title: Shortest Warehouse Walk
problems.statement: In a rectangular grid, 0 means walkable and 1 blocked. Find the minimum number of four-direction moves from top-left to bottom-right. Return -1 if impossible.

problems.title: Equal Load Split
problems.statement: Return true if the nonnegative values can be divided into two groups with exactly the same sum. Every input element must belong to one group.

problems.title: Longest Rising Trend
problems.statement: Find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence. Elements in a subsequence retain original order but need not be adjacent.

problems.title: Unique Zero-Sum Trios
problems.statement: Find all unique value triplets [a,b,c] from distinct positions that sum to zero. Sort numbers inside each triplet ascending, then return triplets in lexicographic order without duplicates.

problems.title: Median Across Sorted Streams
problems.statement: Two non-decreasing integer arrays are given and at least one is non-empty. Return the median of all their values, as a number, without relying on a complete merge for the intended optimal approach.

problems.title: Minimum Text Edits
problems.statement: Return the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, or substitutions needed to transform a into b. Each operation costs one.

problems.title: Longest Correct Bracket Segment
problems.statement: The text contains only parentheses. Return the length of the longest contiguous substring that is a properly balanced parenthesis sequence.

problems.title: Water Between Barriers
problems.statement: Each nonnegative array value is the height of a unit-width wall. Return how many unit squares of water are trapped above the bars after rainfall.

problems.title: Smallest Covering Substring
problems.statement: Find the shortest contiguous substring of text containing every character of required with at least the same multiplicity. Return the earliest window among ties, or an empty string if none exists. Empty required yields an empty string.

problems.title: Largest Rectangle in a Skyline
problems.statement: Given nonnegative heights for adjacent unit-width histogram bars, return the largest rectangular area that fits entirely under the bars.

problems.title: Peak Value per Window
problems.statement: Return the maximum element of every contiguous window of exactly k elements, ordered by the window starting index.

problems.title: One-Letter Word Route
problems.statement: Transform start into end by changing exactly one lowercase letter per step; every intermediate word and end must appear in dictionary. Return the number of words in the shortest sequence, including endpoints; return 0 if impossible. If start equals end, return 1.

problems.title: Cheapest Route with Stop Limit
problems.statement: For directed flights [from,to,cost], find the least total cost from source to destination using at most max_stops intermediate cities (thus at most max_stops+1 edges). Return -1 if impossible.

problems.title: Least-Cost Directed Path
problems.statement: Given n nodes and directed edges [u,v,weight] with nonnegative weights, return the least cost from source to destination, or -1 when unreachable.

problems.title: Strongly Connected Zones
problems.statement: In a directed graph, count maximal groups where every node can reach every other node within the same group. Isolated nodes each form a group.

problems.title: Smallest Valid Task Schedule
problems.statement: For tasks numbered 0 through n-1, directed edge [u,v] requires u before v. Return the lexicographically smallest valid full ordering, or [] if dependencies contain a cycle.

problems.title: Count Nonattacking Queen Layouts
problems.statement: Place n queens on an n-by-n board so no two share a row, column, or diagonal. Return the number of different valid placements.

problems.title: Full Pattern Matcher
problems.statement: Return whether pattern matches the entire text. A dot matches any one character; * means zero or more repetitions of the immediately preceding pattern token. All other lowercase letters match literally.
constraints: Pattern is valid: * never appears first or after another *
Text and literal pattern letters are lowercase a-z

problems.title: Wildcard Filename Rule
problems.statement: Return whether pattern matches the entire text. ? matches any one character; * matches any sequence including empty; other characters match themselves.

problems.title: Longest Mirror Subsequence
problems.statement: Return the length of the longest subsequence of text that reads the same forward and backward. Characters may be skipped without changing order.

problems.title: Maximum Balloon Burst Score
problems.statement: Burst balloons in any order. When balloon i bursts, score the product of its current immediate left neighbor, its own value, and its current immediate right neighbor. Missing neighbors count as 1. Return the maximum total score.

problems.title: Largest Solid Rectangle
problems.statement: Return the area of the largest all-1 axis-aligned rectangle in a rectangular binary grid. Return 0 for an empty grid or no 1 cells.

problems.title: Fewest Palindrome Splits
problems.statement: Split text into contiguous non-empty palindromic pieces using as few cuts as possible. Return the number of cuts. Empty text needs zero cuts.

problems.title: Critical Network Links
problems.statement: In an undirected graph, return all edges whose removal increases the number of connected components. Represent every bridge as [smaller_node, larger_node] and sort all bridges lexicographically.
